practice_quiz.question: Assessment Question 1: Which statement correctly evaluates Democracy and Rule of Law (Unit 1)?
practice_quiz.question_amharic: የምዘና ጥያቄ 1፡ ስለ ዲሞክራሲ (Democracy) እና የሕግ የበላይነት (Rule of Law) (ምዕራፍ 1) ትክክለኛውን መግለጫ የትኛው ነው?
options: Democracy and Rule of Law is a core topic in Grade 9 Civics covering essential principles on pages 6-41.
options_amharic: ዲሞክራሲ (Democracy) እና የሕግ የበላይነት (Rule of Law) በ9ኛ ክፍል ሥነ-ዜጋ (Civics) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 6-41 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።
practice_quiz.correct_answer: Democracy and Rule of Law is a core topic in Grade 9 Civics covering essential principles on pages 6-41.
practice_quiz.correct_answer_amharic: ዲሞክራሲ (Democracy) እና የሕግ የበላይነት (Rule of Law) በ9ኛ ክፍል ሥነ-ዜጋ (Civics) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 6-41 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።
practice_quiz.explanation: Option 1 is correct based on official textbook definition on page 6-41.
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: አማራጭ 1 ትክክለኛ ነው፤ ምክንያቱም በ9ኛ ክፍል ሥነ-ዜጋ (Civics) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 6-41 ላይ ከተቀመጠው ትርጓሜ ጋር ይስማማል።
